about: A merge: two Brain Dump lines under two date headings, one copy in a note the migrator created (Ideas/idea-lamp.md). Both source lines get a pointer to idea-lamp. The record lists the sources paraffin first, though the mains line sits higher in the note (newest date on top), so pointed_lines follows sources order: the paraffin line, then the mains line.
